description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE V (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_V PRIMARY KEY, V MEMO); INSERT rows 1, 2 and 3 with V of 50, 1000 and 2500 U+20AC (100 and 2000 bytes as single LVAL rows on page 45; 5000 bytes chained on pages 47-48); Close. A shared session replaces row 3's 5,000-byte chained value by 4,500 bytes (takes new chain pages, frees old chain pages 47 and 48) with dbFailOnError (RecordsAffected read). After a 1.5 s pause with the database still open, page 0 bytes 3584-3591, page 1 and pages 42-57 are read; then Close, the same pages kept and pages 0-59 hashed, and FieldSize read back. Asks whether freed chain pages are cleared in the LV owned map and marked free in page 1 during the statement or at Close.
retentionNote: r-q22-lv-open: R-FMT-2 long-value open cases (ACE 2007 ACCDB)
